label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: blockers COMPLETE, other edges 9, samples with blocking 27

report.summary: Transfers show 14% 500s and multi-second p95/p99. A session idle in transaction blocked ledger_app sessions 07:08:52-07:09:44. The outbox and consumer look healthy, and the link from blocking to the 500s is not directly confirmed.

findings.claim: Transfers had 94 of 660 requests fail with 500 (14.2%); p95 was 2.2 s and p99 4.1 s.
findings.reason: Request metrics are complete with no counter restarts and show both errors and slow tails.

findings.claim: An idle-in-transaction session (82317) blocked ledger_app sessions for up to 1.69 s between 07:08:52 and 07:09:44.
findings.reason: Historical blocker samples show sessions 80960-80962 waiting on 82317 in 10-15 samples each.

findings.claim: Pool activity overlaps the blocking window (active connections above zero 07:08:53-07:09:43), though the pool never ran out; the blocking plausibly caused the slow and failed transfers.
findings.reason: Active connections peaked at 6 of 10 with no pending borrowers or timeouts, so lock waits, not pool exhaustion, fit the timing. Request timing by minute is not shown.

findings.claim: The outbox and consumer delivery path is not the cause: all 569 attempts succeeded in about 71 ms, and publications track arrivals.
findings.reason: There were no delivery errors and the arrival-minus-publication gap is 1. The failed count of 1034 and the 48,000 s oldest age are static and predate the window.

limitations: Blocking is sampled every 2 s, and the 500s are not broken down by time, so overlap with the 07:08:52-07:09:44 window is not confirmed.
No application error logs or the transaction behind session 82317 were available, so what it was doing is unknown.
next_checks: Get the per-minute transfers 500 count and latency to see whether they cluster in 07:08:52-07:09:44.
Identify the owner and query of session 82317 (idle in transaction) and the application error logs for the 500s.

alternatives.reason: There are no error logs or per-time request breakdown to tie the 500s to the blocking window.
alternatives.hypothesis: The 500s come from something other than the lock waits, such as an application error or a validation path.

alternatives.reason: There were 0 acquisition timeouts, 0 pending borrowers and a max of 6 active connections out of 10.
alternatives.hypothesis: Connection pool exhaustion caused the slowness.

A.rule: a non-ledger_app session blocked ledger_app sessions in 27 samples
